verdict.rationale: LathamDrive's resources page lists a legal document generator that lets entrepreneurs create the documents needed to incorporate a company. Latham also co-developed an Automated Convertible Note generator for capital raising. That covers incorporation and part of the financing story, but the evidence does not show SAFE, term sheet or NDA templates, and never says the tools are free or open to non-clients. Missing for 10: SAFE/term sheet generators, NDA templates, explicit confirmation of free no-engagement access, hands-on or independent corroboration.
